note: Every claim this programme retracted or corrected. Several were withdrawn by its own gates before publication.

errata.claim: A_d spans 2..36 across identical-d codes -- an 18x spread in the leading error prefactor
errata.why: multiplicity was tallied at the depth where the BOUND was met (p=3) rather than where the COUNT is complete (p>=d=6); the flag asserting completeness was hardcoded true
errata.replaced_by: at p=d the raw spread is 1.1x (96..108); what varies is the distribution over logical classes (6..18), and all ten codes share a [24,24,24,8,8,8] core

errata.why: the unlocated arm could not decode a single correctable erasure; the intervals were tight because the comparison was mismatched
errata.replaced_by: V_E = 1.645..2.961 exact ML; ARR stays dead as specified

errata.why: decomposed and undecomposed DEMs are identical -- 17 mechanisms, same herald structure
errata.replaced_by: pymatching discards the grouping at ingestion

errata.why: a candidate cap (weight<=3, data-only) applied to BOTH arms cancelled in the ratio

errata.claim: the multi-engine router is the breakthrough
errata.why: all five closures came from bz.py alone; MITM/SAT/peeling are validated but have produced no promoted closure

errata.claim: G3 fault injection covers the syndrome-preserving blind space
errata.why: random corruption enters a dimension-78 kernel with probability 2^-66; the sampler never visited the blind spot
errata.replaced_by: adversarial injection drawn from ker(H); every blind-spot fault was logical, and the window check caught 100%

errata.claim: the mutation gate is complete at 14/14
errata.why: five mutants had never executed; the first sandboxed run found three survivors and one that had drifted into a SKIP
errata.replaced_by: 19/19 killed, after repairing three decorative checks

errata.claim: CPU and GPU kernels disagree at n=108
errata.why: a CPU timeout misread as substrate disagreement

errata.claim: the independent challenge found 252 violations in 9_6_0172
errata.why: the refutation test was inverted -- it flagged candidates that WERE stabilizers; these codes carry weight-6 stabilizers against d=10, confirmed 4/4 against the rank test
errata.replaced_by: 0 violations; the independent rebuild recovers the certified distance exactly on all ten replicas

errata.claim: the finer invariant finds THREE geometries
errata.why: the descriptor separates three HASHES; proving exactly three isomorphism classes needs a canonical form complete for a declared equivalence relation, with isomorphism witnesses. Rich invariants can still coincide on non-isomorphic structures
errata.replaced_by: three distinct geometry hashes under the current descriptor (stabilizer generators, block-weight vectors, per-block Pauli counts, Pauli-coloured difference multiset) -- exact and safe wording

errata.why: R_b(alpha) is a polynomial in alpha and therefore asymmetric about 1; a single point at alpha=3 was reported as if it were reversible
errata.replaced_by: 3x noisier = 33.75x worse; 3x quieter = 21.60x better. Elasticity at baseline is E[r] = d/2 = 3 on all ten codes, and scaling BOTH blocks by alpha gives exactly alpha^d
